en.headline: Female officer burned after paper shredder fire at Wan Chai police HQ
en.dek: A shredder ignited inside an office in the West Wing of Police Headquarters shortly before 11am; the officer was taken conscious to Ruttonjee Hospital with facial and arm burns.
body: A female police officer suffered burns to her face and arms on Tuesday morning after a paper shredder caught fire inside an office at Police Headquarters in Wan Chai.

The incident was reported at about 10.57am in the West Wing on Arsenal Street. Firefighters and ambulance crews attended; the officer was bandaged on both forearms and had dressings applied to her face before being taken conscious to Ruttonjee Hospital.
Police said the shredder had been in use in an office when it ignited. The cause remains under investigation. No other injuries were reported and the fire was extinguished.

zh.headline: 灣仔警總碎紙機起火 女警面及手燒傷送院
zh.dek: 今早近11時警察總部西翼辦公室碎紙機起火，一名女警面部及雙手前臂燒傷，清醒送往律敦治醫院。
body: 今日早上約10時57分，灣仔軍器廠街警察總部西翼一辦公室內碎紙機突然起火，一名正在使用碎紙機的女警面部及雙手被燒傷。
消防及救護人員到場，傷者雙手前臂包紮繃帶、面部敷上敷料，神智清醒，由救護車送往律敦治醫院治理。
警方表示事件仍在調查中，起火原因有待查明，現場無其他人士受傷，火勢已迅速救熄。
